resources.string: View and export retained details from the last 60 days (up to 500 sessions). Older sessions retain aggregate statistics only.
Deleting reduces totals by %1$d minutes and 1 session. Monthly totals, longest session and streaks update. Pet growth, unlocked achievements and unlock history are retained. Delete?
Some details in this month were archived. Its longest session and listening days cannot be recomputed accurately, so deletion is unavailable.
